text.KJV EZR 2:35: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.
text.BHSA EZR 2:36: הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס
text.KJV EZR 2:36: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
text.BHSA EZR 2:37: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
text.KJV EZR 2:37: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

A.name: Jeshua
A.line: ninth-chosen priest for the twenty-four courses (1CH 24:11)
family: descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

B.name: Jeshua
B.line: returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, NEH 7:7)
B.notes: son of Jozadak who helped to build the altar (EZR 3:2)
family: son-of jozadak (Jozadak, father of Jeshua who built the altar (EZR 3:2))
descendant-of jacob (Jacob, second-born son of Isaac (GEN 25:25-26))

why: לְבֵית יֵשׁוּעַ ('of the house of Jeshua') identifies a priestly household within the list of priestly families, favoring A as an ancestral priestly head. However, neither Jozadak nor the ninth course is mentioned, so the text does not conclusively distinguish A from B.
